summary: Skratch covers active redemption promo codes available for Dragonheir: Silent Gods, including the special Halloween code CANDYTIDE. He also shares his decision to skip the current selectable summon banner to preserve summoning resources. He plans to save his resources for upcoming characters like Serpentemis and Anneliesis instead of whaling further on current banners.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Recommended to preserve summoning resources for her future banner rather than pulling on current selectable banners.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Target hero to save summon resources for on future banners.

tips: Redeem the active promo codes: fastidious14, MORIYA003, volkin02, snap003, and CANDYTIDE for Heliolite Dice, Starlight Stone Dice, Wyrmarrow, Gold, and Stamina.
Consider saving summon resources for high-priority upcoming banners like Serpentemis, Anneliesis, or new Aura heroes instead of spending on selectable summons.
title: GET FREE REWARDS! Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
